item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Traditional Danish roast pork (flæskesteg) made from pork loin with crispy, crackling rind, served with boiled potatoes and a thick brown gravy, topped with parsley. Served with crisp red cabbage salad and pickled gherkins. The dish is gluten free. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Persian kofteh rizeh, spiced minced beef mixed with grated vegetables, turmeric, sumac and chopped parsley, lightly fried and finished in a rich stock, served with saffron basmati rice and topped with parsley. Served with oven-roasted tomato and a cool garlic yoghurt with mint. The dish is gluten free. (6+9+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Persian plant-based kofteh rizeh, spiced minced pea protein mixed with grated vegetables, turmeric, sumac and chopped parsley, lightly fried and finished in a rich stock, served with saffron basmati rice and topped with parsley. Served with oven-roasted tomato and a cool garlic yoghurt with mint. The dish is gluten free. (6+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Bøf Lindstrøm (Danish beef patty with capers and beetroot) with pan gravy, soft onions and roast potatoes. (1+6+10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mushroom patty with soft onions and roast potatoes. (1+6+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Pulled beef burrito with rice, cheese, avocado cream and chipotle. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Burrito with beans and pulled jackfruit, cheese, avocado cream and chipotle. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Loaded beef potato petal poutine, a basket of golden, crispy potato petals smothered in a rich, velvety slow-simmered beef sauce with vegetables and minced beef, topped with diced cheese and parsley. Served with chilli sauce and a fresh, crisp green apple and celery salad in a light cider vinaigrette. The dish is gluten free. (6+10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: potato petal poutine, a basket of golden, crispy potato petals smothered in a rich, velvety slow-simmered vegetarian sauce with vegetables and mushrooms, topped with diced cheese and parsley. Served with chilli sauce and a fresh, crisp green apple and celery salad in a light cider vinaigrette. The dish is gluten free. (6+10+15)
